email.subject: A website preview for Mrs. Wilson's Cafe
email.body:
Hello Mrs. Wilson's Cafe team,

I prepared a simple website preview for your cafe using the public business details we found. It is only a concept for your review. If you are interested, I can customize it, deploy it, and add backend features after confirming the exact requirements and a small budget.

Thank you.
